title: Decision models for UAVBench and the viability of edge deployment
abstract: arXiv:2611.28331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Small language models are often proposed for reasoning onboard a drone. However, a good benchmark score does not tell us whether a model will actually run, and run usefully, on an edge computer. In this paper we study three related questions using the UAV decision benchmark, UAVBench. First, are small structured decision models good candidates for these tasks? Second, can an ordinary local machine (a Mac) screen candidate models before we test them on physical devices? Third, what software and resource limits govern deployment? Our main Mac evaluation covers 24 model configurations on the same 2,000 validated multiple-choice questions from UAVBench. These include 20 size-and-precision configurations of 11 generative models, plus four open-weight structured decision models that received no additional UAVBench-specific training. translated_title: UAVBench的决策模型与边缘部署的可行性
translated_abstract: 小语言模型常被提议用于无人机机载推理任务。然而，良好的基准测试分数并不能告诉我们一个模型是否真的能在边缘计算机上运行，并且有效运行。本文使用无人机决策基准UAVBench研究了三个相关问题：第一，小型结构化决策模型是否是这些任务的良好候选？第二，在物理设备上进行测试之前，普通的本地机器（Mac）能否筛选候选模型？第三，哪些软件和资源限制决定了部署？我们在Mac上的主要评估涵盖了来自UAVBench的2,000个经验证的多选题上的24个模型配置。其中包括11个生成式模型的20种大小和精度配置，以及四个未接受额外UAVBench特定训练的开源权重结构化决策模型。结构化决策模型H2O Lightning 4B取得了我们所观察到的最高准确率，达到了77.65%。
tldr: 本文基于UAVBench基准发现，小型结构化决策模型（如H2O Lightning 4B以77.65%的准确率表现最佳）是无人机机载决策任务的优秀候选，且普通Mac电脑即可有效筛选候选模型、评估边缘部署的软件与资源可行性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows via UAVBench that small structured decision models (with H2O Lightning 4B achieving the highest accuracy of 77.65%) are strong candidates for onboard UAV decision-making, and that an ordinary Mac can effectively screen candidate models and assess the software and resource limits for edge deployment.
